pattern: EX duplicate job raised automatically from a tenant chase leads to one visit being invoiced twice; pay one, query the other

Events 022-024 are new: the system raised a second request from that email, assigned a provider and sent Riverside a 'new Dishwasher Repair Request' (the failure under test: the duplicate the base case warns against, made by automation). Event 025 is the source's 29/04 09:06 call, with the source's stray provider name ('Noah from Meadow Services') replaced by Riverside's engineer so only one provider is in play. Event 026 is the source's 02/05 'No work results' update (its identical twin, source 023, dropped). Event 027 (Sunday 03/05/2026 14:58 UTC, Email, Contractor) carries two invoices, RC-2291 and RC-2292, each £110 + VAT = £132, for the same 29/04 attendance, plus the source's own work note from event 024. Total 27, marker 028. The landlord's agreement (event 008) named no figure. Expected: record the work result, process RC-2291 only (or ask Imogen to confirm £132 first), query or hold RC-2292 as a duplicate, cancel the duplicate request; no escalation, no new job.
